name: axioma-studio/vaulter-core
description: Embeddable document management for Laravel — file manager, TipTap editor, version history and real-time collaboration, integrated through adapters.

suggest.spatie/laravel-permission: Required only when using the 'spatie' host-role driver (^8.0).
suggest.axioma-studio/vaulter-filament: Filament admin UI for documents, folders and permissions.
suggest.axioma-studio/vaulter-media: Content-addressed file/blob layer (CAS): the concrete ContentStore/StorageDriver/BlobStore engine behind the Contracts\Cas seam. Required for Drive file upload/download/versioning.
suggest.axioma-studio/vaulter-drive: File/folder tree behaviour + resumable uploads: StorageManager, the DriveHandle factory, PurgeTrash/SweepUploads. Required for Vaulter::for()/forStorage() and the Drive REST surface.
suggest.axioma-studio/vaulter-documents: Document-node behaviour: the format-handler registry, TipTap/export engines and real-time collaboration (Hocuspocus JWT minting needs firebase/php-jwt ^6.0). Required for Vaulter::registerHandler()/registerExporter() and the document REST surface.
